message.content:
No, I can’t look at any one company’s flights. My job is just to keep the shared airspace picture up to date—like the zones, corridors, and closures—and tell the companies how many of their sites or routes are affected by a closure. If a closure blocks a corridor, I’ll say how many companies are impacted, but I don’t know which drones were flying there or which company they belong to.

If a company wants to know how a closure hit them specifically, they’d have to ask their own systems. We don’t track individual flights or company data.
